Fix the ts to 02:29-02:37. Minor: soften 'the single most consequential gap' framing in coaching_focus priority 1 given the call had no viable path to booking regardless of empathy shown. Optional: flag the ambiguous bill figure (120/223/150 all mentioned within seconds) in bill_anchor_audit rather than silently picking 120.
